headline: Candidate Who Cleared Competitive Exam By Sitting For It In Five Different Disguises Claims He Was Just Exploring His Artistic Range
body:
Q: Everyone is shocked that you managed to sit for the same civil service exam five times in one day using different prosthetic mustaches and regional accents. What was the strategy?

A: It wasn't about the job, honestly. I’m a method actor. I wanted to see if the exam center’s biometric scanners were as sensitive to internal existential dread as they were to fingerprints. It’s hard to stay in character when the invigilator keeps asking why you’ve changed from a Haryanvi farmer into a tech-bro from Bengaluru in the span of thirty minutes.

Q: The authorities seem to think it was a sophisticated attempt to ensure a family member’s passing grade by sheer volume of probability. How do you respond to that?

A: That’s a very narrow, bureaucratic way of looking at a multi-disciplinary performance piece. My brother was just there to hold my prop briefcase, which contained nothing but high-protein snacks and a printed copy of the constitutional assembly debates. If he happened to accidentally fill out the OMR sheet while I was changing my contact lenses, that's just a tragic accident of proximity.

Q: Are you worried about the investigation into these recurring identities?

A: Not at all. I’ve already auditioned for the role of the lead investigator. Once I start questioning myself, the whole thing becomes a closed loop, and the authorities will have to release me due to a lack of available actors to play the prosecution.
caption: Method acting has gone too far. If you can't pass the exam with one identity, try five. Or maybe just study? #ExamScam #MethodActing #JSSC #CompetitiveExams (satire)
